lines.text: A pond has two hundred fish, ninety percent goldfish.
lines.caption: A pond has two hundred fish, ninety percent goldfish.

lines.text: Remove goldfish until eighty percent remain. Most kids say ten!
lines.caption: Remove goldfish until eighty percent remain. Most kids say ten!

lines.text: How many goldfish must go, so that eighty percent of the fish left are goldfish?
lines.caption: How many goldfish must go, so that eighty percent of the fish left are goldfish?

lines.text: Watch the fish that stay! One hundred eighty goldfish, so twenty other fish.
lines.caption: Watch the fish that stay! One hundred eighty goldfish, so twenty other fish.

lines.text: Those twenty never leave. At the end they're twenty percent, one fifth of the pond.
lines.caption: Those twenty never leave. At the end they're twenty percent, one fifth of the pond.

lines.text: So the whole pond is five times twenty, one hundred fish.
lines.caption: So the whole pond is five times twenty, one hundred fish.

lines.text: Two hundred fish down to one hundred. So one hundred goldfish must go!
lines.caption: Two hundred fish down to one hundred. So one hundred goldfish must go!

lines.text: Not ninety minus eighty. The total changes!
lines.caption: Not ninety minus eighty. The total changes!

lines.text: Why not ten? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why not ten? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
